id: title:MattBro:run the enrichment recheck in its own workflow

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a new Temporal workflow registration and implementation for SignupEnrichmentRecheckWorkflow, including execution, timer, and activity, alongside test fixtures.
review.reason: The production code adds a workflow registration and implementation, while the test-only chunk adds corresponding test execution. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of production implementation and tests, but the specific business benefit or operational impact of this workflow is not demonstrated in the supplied observations.

observations.limitations: This chunk represents a single, cohesive change group. P1.F1.H1 adds a workflow registration. P1.F3.H1 and P1.F3.H2 add the workflow implementation and its test setup. P1.F2.H1 adds a replay fixture. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment requested.

observations.behavior: Adds SignupEnrichmentRecheckWorkflow to the WORKFLOWS registry, making it executable by the Temporal worker.
